title: Decision register
description: data/decisions.json: every human decision about a finding, once (CR26; replaces the POA&M). scripts/_decisions.py enforces these rules at build time without a jsonschema dependency, plus the cross-record ones a schema cannot state: IDs and former IDs are unique, and a check or vulnerability ID is claimed by at most one in-force record. A record past review_by is lapsed: the VDR builder and the vulnerability gate treat it as absent.

former_id.description: The POA&M item this record was carried over from.

disposition.description: risk-accepted and false-positive records may suppress configuration-scanner checks; the vulnerability gate passes false-positive, accepted, operational-requirement, mitigated and vendor-dependency; under-investigation and remediate are recorded but do not pass.

planned_reduction.description: The next planned reduction in Potential Agency Impact (VER-RPT-VDT): the date it is expected and the rating it brings the finding to. Published as the finding's projectedNextReduction in place of the remediation deadline. In-force records only.

check_ids.description: Checkov/tfsec check IDs this record suppresses or classifies.

vuln_ids.description: The ID the vulnerability gate resolves for a finding: its CVE when it has one, else the scanner tracking ID (e.g. grype-{vuln-id}-{purl}, zap-{alert-ref}), else the tool ID.

vuln_fields.description: Vulnerability-specific fields copied onto the gate's entry (e.g. mitigation: a mitigation record ID).
